Context: 5. Entitlement

- (c) Journey by road.Entitlements will be the same as in case of journeys undertaken on transfer. Reimbursement shall be admissible for journeys performed in a vehicle operated by the Government or any corporation in the public sector run by Central or State Government or a local body.
